candidates.name: Josh Shapiro
candidates.background: Governor of Pennsylvania since 2023; former state Attorney General.

cost.label: Repeatedly proposed raising the minimum wage to $15 (Wikipedia)

taxes.label: Championed cutting the corporate tax rate from 8.99% to 4.99% (Wikipedia)

climate.label: Mixed: 'skeptical' of the RGGI cap-and-trade program, backs clean-energy expansion (Wikipedia)

education.label: Mixed: $1.1B public-school funding boost AND supports lifeline-scholarship ESAs (Wikipedia)

safety.label: Signed parole reform; paused executions and backs abolishing the death penalty (Wikipedia)

repro.label: Pledged to veto abortion restrictions; ended state contract with anti-abortion Real Alternatives (Wikipedia)

health.label: Fought federal Medicaid cuts, backs higher Medicaid reimbursement rates, funded rural hospitals (Spotlight PA)

housing.label: Mixed: Housing Action Plan cuts red tape to build, plus $1B affordable-housing bond and rental-application-fee cap (Office of the Governor)

immigration.label: Declined GOP calls to send the National Guard to the border; has criticized ICE tactics (Wikipedia)

sources.label: Office of the Governor: Housing Action Plan

candidates.name: Stacy Garrity
candidates.background: Pennsylvania State Treasurer since 2021; retired U.S. Army Reserve colonel, three Bronze Stars.

taxes.label: Fiscal-hawk record as treasurer: opposed spending programs, cost-focused critiques (Wikipedia)

climate.label: Threatened state divestment from banks that cut fossil-fuel financing (Wikipedia)

democracy.label: Spoke at Jan 5, 2021 rally urging decertification of 2020 results; endorsed Trump fraud claims (Wikipedia)

cost.label: 'Unleash the liquid fuel that we have at our feet' to cut energy prices; lower property taxes for seniors (Spotlight PA)

health.label: Mixed: backed federal package including Medicaid cuts, yet proposes higher rural Medicaid rates and a Rural Health Emergency (Spotlight PA)

immigration.label: Says ICE detention-center proposals warrant serious review; would 'work with any president'; calls Shapiro's opposition posturing (Spotlight PA)

education.label: 'Parents, not bureaucrats, should be deciding'; backs charters, cyber charters and private-school scholarships (Spotlight PA)

repro.label: Called the ruling ending PA's Medicaid abortion ban 'immoral,' opposes taxpayer funding; says abortion policy is up to legislators (Spotlight PA)
